checks.title: HTTPS enabled
checks.detail: Page is not served over HTTPS
checks.fix: Install a TLS certificate (Let's Encrypt is free) and 301 all http URLs to https. Chrome marks http pages 'Not secure'.

checks.title: http redirects to https
checks.detail: HTTPS is not working, so this cannot be checked

checks.title: One canonical hostname
checks.detail: Only one host variant responded, so this is fine

checks.title: Text compression
checks.fix: Enable gzip or brotli compression on the server/CDN.

checks.title: Cache headers
checks.detail: No cache-control header on the HTML response
checks.fix: Add Cache-Control and an ETag so repeat visits and crawls are cheap.

checks.title: Content present in the served HTML
checks.detail: The server-delivered HTML contains only 0 words of visible text. This is a JavaScript-rendered single-page app: the crawler receives an empty shell plus a script tag.
checks.fix: Prerender or server-render the page. Options, easiest first: (1) generate a static HTML snapshot of the page at build time and serve that to crawlers (vite-plugin-prerender, react-snap); (2) move to a framework with SSR/SSG (Next.js, Astro, Remix); (3) at minimum, put the real copy inside <noscript> and add a prerendered HTML fallback. AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) never execute JavaScript, so a client-only page can never be cited by them.

checks.title: robots.txt present
checks.fix: Publish a robots.txt at the site root so crawlers know the rules.

checks.title: XML sitemap
checks.detail: No sitemap found at /sitemap.xml or declared in robots.txt
checks.fix: Generate an XML sitemap, list every canonical URL in it, and declare it in robots.txt.

checks.title: Page is indexable
checks.detail: meta robots: 'index, follow, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large, max-video-preview:-1'

checks.title: Canonical tag
checks.detail: https://ais-dev-uyn2sokqgf5kyhhqz4sznz-933176374351.asia-east1.run.app/ — points to a DIFFERENT site, check this

checks.title: Title tag length
checks.evidence: Ludo Emperor 5 Way | 5-Player Pentagonal Dual-Dice Ludo

checks.title: Meta description length
checks.evidence: Experience 5-player asymmetric Ludo with dual-dice splitting, Lucky 7 base deployments, and anti-leader warzone mechanics. Play free in your browser today.

checks.title: Exactly one H1
checks.fix: Add one H1 that states what the page is about, using the primary keyword naturally.

checks.title: Subheadings (H2)
checks.fix: Break the page into H2 sections. Long unbroken text is hard to scan and hard for AI to quote.

checks.title: Content depth
checks.fix: Expand to at least 600 words of genuinely useful detail. Cover the questions a buyer asks before purchasing.

checks.title: Keyword alignment
checks.fix: Put the primary keyword in the title, the H1, the URL slug and the first 100 words.

checks.title: Internal links in body
checks.fix: Add contextual internal links from this page to related products, categories and guides. Internal links spread authority and help crawlers.

checks.title: Structured data present
checks.detail: 8 type(s): AggregateRating, ItemList, ListItem, Offer, QuantitativeValue, SoftwareApplication, VideoGame, WebSite

checks.title: Trust pages exist
checks.detail: Missing core pages: About page, Contact page, Privacy policy, Terms of service
checks.fix: Publish About, Contact, Privacy Policy and Terms pages. They are E-E-A-T signals and AI engines check them before citing a source.

checks.title: FAQPage schema
checks.fix: Add FAQPage JSON-LD with 5-10 real customer questions and concise answers. This is the single highest-leverage AEO change.

checks.title: HowTo schema
checks.detail: No HowTo schema (only needed if you publish step-by-step guides)
checks.fix: For any process/installation/guide page, add HowTo JSON-LD with numbered steps.

checks.title: Question-form headings
checks.fix: Rewrite or add H2/H3 headings as real questions ("How much does X cost?", "What is the difference between X and Y?"). These are what People Also Ask pulls from.

checks.title: Answers are 40-60 words
checks.detail: No question/answer pairs detected on the page
checks.fix: Add a FAQ section: question as the heading, 40-60 word answer immediately below.

checks.title: Bulleted / numbered lists
checks.fix: Convert features, specs, steps and options into bullet lists. Lists are far easier to lift into an answer box.

checks.title: Tables for comparison
checks.fix: Add at least one comparison or specification table. Tables are prime snippet and AI-summary material.

checks.title: Descriptive headings
checks.fix: Add an H1 and H2 sections.

checks.title: Sentence length
checks.detail: Only 0 sentence(s) with terminal punctuation were found, so readability cannot be judged reliably (common on list-heavy product and category pages)

checks.title: Content readable without JavaScript
checks.detail: AI crawlers were served 0 words of visible text. GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot do not execute JavaScript, so they see an empty page and cannot cite it under any circumstances.
checks.fix: Prerender or SSR the content. Until the text is in the HTML response, no amount of schema or copywriting can get this site quoted by an AI answer engine. This is the single biggest GEO blocker.

checks.title: AI crawlers allowed
checks.detail: robots.txt not readable, so crawler access could not be checked

checks.title: Cites authoritative sources
checks.detail: No outbound links to authoritative sources
checks.fix: Add citations: link claims to primary sources. Pages with visible sourcing are dramatically more likely to be quoted by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

checks.title: Quantitative facts
checks.fix: Add concrete numbers: prices, dimensions, weights, success rates, timelines. AI summarisers prefer specific, verifiable statements over marketing adjectives.

checks.title: Named author
checks.fix: Add a named author with a one-line credential and a link to an author page. Author identity is an E-E-A-T signal that AI engines weigh.

checks.title: Person schema
checks.fix: Add Person JSON-LD with name, jobTitle, url and sameAs (LinkedIn, X/Twitter). This is how an AI engine connects your content to a real entity.

checks.title: sameAs entity links
checks.detail: Organization schema has no sameAs array
checks.fix: List every official profile (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Wikipedia) in sameAs so AI engines can resolve your brand as one entity.

checks.title: Entity-rich content
checks.detail: Few named entities (0.0 proper nouns/100 words)
checks.fix: Name the specific products, brands, places, standards and models instead of writing generically. AI retrieval works on entities.

checks.title: Publish / update dates
checks.fix: Add visible and machine-readable publish and last-updated dates.

checks.title: Machine-parseable formatting
checks.detail: No tables or lists on the page
checks.fix: Use tables for comparisons and specs, and lists for options and steps. Plain prose is much harder for an AI to lift cleanly.

checks.title: Q&A pairs for summarisation
checks.fix: Add an FAQ block. It is what Perplexity and AI Overviews quote most often.

checks.title: llms.txt
checks.detail: No /llms.txt (optional; the convention is still emerging, low cost to add: a markdown index of your key pages)

checks.title: E-E-A-T surface area
checks.detail: Only 0/8 trust pages found (missing: about, contact, privacy, terms, blog, shipping, returns, faq)
checks.fix: Publish About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Shipping and Returns pages. AI engines check whether a store is a real, accountable business before recommending it.

checks.title: Semantic HTML landmarks
checks.fix: Wrap content in <main> and <article> and use <nav>. Landmarks help extraction pipelines isolate the real content from the chrome.

checks.title: Quotable sentence length
checks.detail: Not enough punctuated prose to measure (list/table-heavy page)

checks.title: Third-party presence (Reddit, Quora, industry sites)
checks.detail: Not auto-checked — this tool does not query reddit/quora without a SERP key. AI engines lean on sources they have already seen discussed elsewhere.
checks.fix: Manually search `<brand> site:reddit.com`, `<brand> site:quora.com` and your top 3 industry publications. If nothing comes up, that is your GEO gap: contribute genuine answers and get listed in industry directories and comparison articles.
